summary: An on-call worker borrows a car to reach a rural client.
realLife: Adams said he sometimes borrowed a car from his stepchildren or friends to get to clients because he did not own one.
gates: The worker has a client visit and lacks reliable transportation.
inGame: needs: an available car or a transit route that serves the visit.

turns.pulledBy: A scheduled route serves the visit on time.
turns.writesBack: The visit is covered without the loan.

turns.what: The car is available for only part of the route.
turns.pulledBy: The owner needs it back before the last call.
turns.writesBack: The coordinator must cover the remaining visit.
